title: The Copper Compass
author: Sebastian Pemberton
blurb: Elodie Reyes, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
